name.zh: 星屑双奏·精细动漫回旋构图
name.en: Stellar duet: polished anime with sweeping arcs

note.zh: 精细动漫角色主视觉，深底与粉金流动形体结合。
note.en: Polished anime character key visual combining a dark ground with flowing pink and gold forms.

note.zh: 近黑背景衬托粉色和金色大色组，肤色浅，眼睛有小面积冷色。
note.en: A near-black ground supports large pink and gold groups, pale skin and small cool eye accents.

note.zh: 头发出现带状高光，皮肤较柔和，局部衣料反光较锐利。
note.en: Hair has banded highlights, skin softer modeling and selected sharper clothing reflections.

note.zh: 粉发在上方形成大空环，金发在下方形成回旋扇面，两者交错。
note.en: Pink hair forms a large open upper loop, while gold hair forms a lower swirling fan; the two interlock.

note.zh: 长发占据的画面范围显著大于身体，人物上下错位。
note.en: Hair spans a much larger region than the bodies, with the figures vertically offset.

note.zh: 大眼睛多亮点，鼻口简化，手势和四肢保持动漫化结构。
note.en: Large eyes have multiple highlights; noses and mouths are simplified, with structured anime gestures and limbs.

note.zh: 阴影有明确分区，同时存在局部柔和过渡。
note.en: Shadows have distinct shapes together with localized soft transitions.

note.zh: 轮廓纤细清楚，发束内部线条疏密有别。
note.en: Contours are fine and clear, with varied internal line density in hair locks.

note.zh: 眼睛和高光精修，少量十字星芒和竖向细光痕辅助。
note.en: Eyes and highlights are carefully resolved, supported by a few cross-shaped sparkles and thin vertical light traces.

note.zh: 表面整体光洁，发丝概括为片状发束，背景为离散亮点。
note.en: Surfaces are smooth, hair is grouped into broad locks and the background uses discrete points of light.

note.zh: 细节集中在眼睛、衣饰和发束转折，外围多为暗空间与稀疏星点。
note.en: Detail concentrates in eyes, costume accents and hair turns; outer regions are dark space with sparse stars.

note.zh: 两张脸与亮色发束转折形成上下注意锚点。
note.en: Two faces and turns in bright hair locks form vertically arranged anchors.

note.zh: 静暗背景与明亮动势、纤细身体与夸张长发形成对照。
note.en: A quiet dark ground contrasts with bright motion, and slender bodies with exaggerated hair.

references.source: User-provided pink-and-gold anime duo illustration in this conversation; author, character identities and original production method unverified.

instruction.zh: 以精细动漫线稿配合分块阴影和克制的局部渐变，避免纯平面剪纸、粗厚笔触和写实三维。
instruction.en: Combine refined anime linework with shaped cel shadows and restrained local gradients; avoid purely flat cut-paper rendering, heavy brushwork and photorealistic 3D.
